# NIST AI RMF Static RAG Demo

> Dual-readable Markdown extracts of NIST AI RMF 1.0 (NIST.AI.100-1) and the Generative AI Profile (NIST.AI.600-1), plus a static hybrid retrieval demo with section citations. **Opt-in sibling corpus:** SP 800-53 Rev 5 statement + guidance under `/nist-ai-rmf/sp800-53/` (not blended into default AI RMF ranking). **Not official NIST output.** Cite the official DOIs for normative use: https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.100-1 , https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.600-1 , https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-53r5
>
> Demo home: https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/
> This corpus is separate from the CoSAI SRF knowledge graph and from the TACIP orphan at /nist/.

## How agents should use this corpus

1. **Authoritative quote / cite:** fetch the clean Markdown sources below; quote by `section_path` / heading anchor. Prefer the official NIST PDF/DOI when the answer is normative.
2. **Programmatic scenario retrieval (plain HTTP, pure JSON):** fetch a precomputed file under `/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/` (see index below), or fetch `data/chunks.json` (+ manifest) and rank locally.
3. **SP 800-53 (opt-in, separate):** fetch [sp800-53/data/chunks.json](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sp800-53/data/chunks.json) or family Markdown under [sp800-53/sources/](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sp800-53/sources/index.md). Do **not** merge those chunks into AI RMF ranking unless the user explicitly asked for SP 800-53.
4. **Always verify** citations against the source Markdown (or official PDF).
5. **Do not** treat fused scores as official NIST guidance.
6. **Do not** use `?format=json` as a general agent endpoint. A plain GET returns the HTML page shell; ranking only runs if client JavaScript executes. Prefer `/retrieve/*.json`, `data/chunks.json`, or `sp800-53/data/chunks.json`.
7. **Applicability:** NIST.AI.600-1 supplements and does not replace NIST.AI.100-1.
8. **Human + agent howto:** [HOWTO.md](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/HOWTO.md). Guide: https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/#what-this-is
9. **What this demonstrates:** https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/#what-this-demonstrates
10. **Operational risk:** https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/#assistant-ot-risks

## Programmatic retrieval (static JSON over HTTP)

### Precomputed AI RMF scenario results (recommended for agents)

- [Scenario index](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/index.json)
- [human-oversight](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/human-oversight.json)
- [confabulation](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/confabulation.json)
- [govern-inventory](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/govern-inventory.json)
- [supply-chain](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/supply-chain.json)
- [prompt-injection](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/retrieve/prompt-injection.json)

Each file is ranked hybrid retrieval output (`matched_chunks`, scores, citations). Content-Type is `application/json` on GitHub Pages.

### AI RMF corpus (default; rank locally)

- [Corpus manifest](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/corpus-manifest.json)
- [Chunks](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/chunks.json)
- [BM25 index](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/bm25.json)
- [Embeddings](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/embeddings.json)
- [Graph edges](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/graph-edges.json)

### SP 800-53 Rev 5 corpus (opt-in; not blended)

- [Corpus manifest](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sp800-53/data/corpus-manifest.json)
- [Chunks](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sp800-53/data/chunks.json)
- [BM25 index](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sp800-53/data/bm25.json)
- [Embeddings](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sp800-53/data/embeddings.json)
- Scope: control statement + guidance only (no 800-53A assessment procedures, no 800-53B baselines).

## Browser UI only

- Interactive UI: https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/?q=...
- SP 800-53 opt-in: https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/?doc=sp800-53-rev5&q=AC-2%20account%20management
- `?format=json` is a **browser debug mode** (requires JS). It is not a server-side JSON API.
